items.prompt: Residuals are positive at both predictor extremes and negative in the middle. What is a sensible next step?

options.text: Ignore the pattern because average residual is zero
options.why: An intercept fit already forces that average to zero.

options.text: Delete every observation with a nonzero residual
options.why: That selects data to force a desired fit.

options.text: Declare causation from the shape alone
options.why: A residual pattern does not identify a causal effect.

options.text: Investigate curvature and test revisions on untouched data
options.why: The pattern suggests a mean-model issue, not automatic proof of a specific replacement.

items.explanation: Use diagnostics to form a checkable revision, preserving an honest evaluation set instead of reusing it for model selection.
